title: Revitalized Donburi with Wilted Greens
description: A creative twist on the classic donburi, adding wilted greens for an extra nutritional boost. This Japanese-inspired dish is perfect for a quick and easy meal.

ingredients.name: Wilted greens (such as spinach or kale)

instructions: 1. Cook the donburi according to package instructions.
2. In a separate pan, heat the soy sauce over medium heat.
3. Add the wilted greens to the pan and stir until well coated with the soy sauce.
4. Top the cooked donburi with the wilted greens mixture.
5. Sprinkle grated cheddar cheese on top (if using).
